info.title: HandsFreeOS API
info.description: Every write goes through a command; every read through a query. Same operations for the web app, mobile, the assistant and integrations.

post.summary: Create your organization and its first workspace. You become Owner of both.
post.description: Risk level 1. Emits organization.created, workspace.created.

post.summary: Add another business (workspace) to an organization you administer.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires workspace.create. Emits workspace.created.

post.summary: Change a workspace name, time zone, industry or settings.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires workspace.update. Emits workspace.updated.

post.summary: Invite someone to a workspace by email. They receive a single-use link that expires in 7 days.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires members.invite. Emits invitation.created.

post.summary: Send a pending invitation again with a fresh link; the old link stops working.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires members.invite. Emits invitation.resend_requested.

post.summary: Cancel a pending invitation so its link no longer works.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires invitations.revoke. Emits invitation.revoked.

post.summary: Accept an invitation link. Works once, for the email it was sent to.
post.description: Risk level 1. Emits invitation.accepted, membership.created.

post.summary: Change a teammate's role in a workspace.
post.description: Risk level 3. Requires members.change_role. Emits membership.role_changed.

post.summary: Remove a teammate from a workspace, or leave it yourself.
post.description: Risk level 3. Requires workspace.read. Emits membership.removed.

post.summary: Update your own name, photo or preferences.
post.description: Risk level 1. Emits user.profile_updated.

post.summary: Add a pipeline with its stages (the default template is New, Contacted, Estimate sent, Won, Lost).
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires pipelines.manage. Emits pipeline.created.

post.summary: Rename or reorder a pipeline.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires pipelines.manage. Emits pipeline.updated.

post.summary: Archive a pipeline that has no open leads. The last active pipeline stays.
post.description: Risk level 3. Requires pipelines.manage. Emits pipeline.archived.

post.summary: Add a stage to a pipeline, at the end or right after another stage.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires pipelines.manage. Emits stage.created.

post.summary: Rename a stage or change what it means (open, won or lost). Kind changes need an empty stage.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires pipelines.manage. Emits stage.updated.

post.summary: Set the order of every stage in a pipeline.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires pipelines.manage. Emits stage.reordered.

post.summary: Delete a stage. Leads in it move to another stage of the same kind.
post.description: Risk level 3. Requires pipelines.manage. Emits stage.deleted.

post.summary: Add a company. Warns when one with the same email, phone or name already exists.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires records.write. Emits company.created.

post.summary: Change a company’s details.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires records.write. Emits company.updated.

post.summary: Archive a company. Refused while it has open leads or tasks unless forced, which archives the leads too.
post.description: Risk level 3. Requires records.archive. Emits company.archived.

post.summary: Bring an archived company back.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires records.archive. Emits company.restored.

post.summary: Add a person. Warns when someone with the same email or phone already exists.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires records.write. Emits person.created.

post.summary: Change a person’s details. Changing the company also moves their open leads to it.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires records.write. Emits person.updated.

post.summary: Archive a person. Refused while they have open leads or tasks unless forced, which archives the leads too.
post.description: Risk level 3. Requires records.archive. Emits person.archived.

post.summary: Bring an archived person back.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires records.archive. Emits person.restored.

post.summary: Add a tag to the workspace.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires records.write. Emits tag.created.

post.summary: Rename or recolor a tag everywhere it is used.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires tags.manage. Emits tag.updated.

post.summary: Delete a tag and remove it from every record.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires tags.manage. Emits tag.deleted.

post.summary: Replace the tags on a person, company or lead.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires records.write. Emits record.tags_changed.

post.summary: Add a lead for a person or company. It starts in the first open stage of the pipeline.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires records.write. Emits lead.created.

post.summary: Change a lead’s title, value, source, people, expected close date or assignee.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires records.write. Emits lead.updated, lead.assigned.

post.summary: Move a lead to another stage of its pipeline (and to a spot within it). A lost stage needs a reason.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires records.write. Emits lead.stage_changed, lead.won, lead.lost, lead.reopened.

post.summary: Set or clear the one thing to do next on a lead, and when.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires records.write. Emits lead.next_action_set, lead.next_action_cleared.

post.summary: Archive a lead so it leaves the pipeline without losing its history.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires records.archive. Emits lead.archived.

post.summary: Bring an archived lead back to its stage.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires records.archive. Emits lead.restored.

post.summary: Add a task, optionally tied to a person, company or lead and assigned to someone.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires records.write. Emits task.created.

post.summary: Change a task’s title, notes, due date, assignee or related records.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires records.write. Emits task.updated.

post.summary: Mark a task done.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires records.write. Emits task.completed.

post.summary: Reopen a completed task.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires records.write. Emits task.reopened.

post.summary: Delete a task you created (owners and admins can delete any).
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires records.write. Emits task.deleted.

post.summary: Log a note, call or visit on a person, company or lead.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires records.write. Emits activity.logged.

post.summary: Edit a note, call or visit you logged.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires records.write. Emits activity.updated.

post.summary: Delete a note, call or visit (yours, or any as an owner or admin).
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires records.write. Emits activity.deleted.

post.summary: Reserve a place for a file on a record. Upload to the returned path, then confirm.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires records.write. Emits .

post.summary: Mark an uploaded file ready once the object exists in storage.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires records.write. Emits file.attached.

post.summary: Remove a file from a record. The worker deletes the stored object afterwards.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires records.write. Emits file.deleted.

post.summary: Reserve an import. Upload the CSV to the returned path, then start it with a column mapping.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires records.import. Emits .

post.summary: Start a reserved import with the column mapping and how to treat matches.
post.description: Risk level 3. Requires records.import. Emits import.requested.

post.summary: Stop an import that is pending or running. Rows already imported stay.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires records.import. Emits import.cancelled.

post.summary: Buy the workspace’s business number from the search results. HandsFreeOS provisions it with the carrier; calls ring as soon as it is active.
post.description: Risk level 3. Requires channels.manage. Emits phone_number.purchase_requested.

post.summary: Give the business number back to the carrier. Calls and texts to it stop, and it cannot be recovered.
post.description: Risk level 4. Requires channels.manage. Emits phone_number.release_requested.

post.summary: Choose which phones ring with the browsers when a customer calls, how long they ring, and the voicemail greeting.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires channels.manage. Emits phone_number.routing_updated.

post.summary: Quiet hours for texts and the reminder email when a customer waits for a reply.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires channels.manage. Emits phone.settings_updated.

post.summary: Send the business details the carriers need before texts can go out: toll-free verification, or the 10DLC brand and campaign for a local number.
post.description: Risk level 3. Requires channels.manage. Emits registration.submitted.

post.summary: Open the text or email conversation with a customer, starting it if needed.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires inbox.use. Emits conversation.created, conversation.linked.

post.summary: Mark a conversation read for the whole team.
post.description: Risk level 0. Requires inbox.use. Emits conversation.read.

post.summary: Mark a conversation unread so it stands out in the inbox again.
post.description: Risk level 0. Requires inbox.use. Emits conversation.marked_unread.

post.summary: Give a conversation to a teammate, or leave it for anyone.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires inbox.use. Emits conversation.assigned.

post.summary: Hide a conversation until a set time. It comes back then, or sooner if the customer writes again.
post.description: Risk level 0. Requires inbox.use. Emits conversation.snoozed.

post.summary: Close a conversation that needs nothing more. A new message opens it again.
post.description: Risk level 0. Requires inbox.use. Emits conversation.closed.

post.summary: Bring a closed or snoozed conversation back into the inbox.
post.description: Risk level 0. Requires inbox.use. Emits conversation.reopened.

post.summary: Tie a conversation from an unknown number or address to a customer. Earlier messages and calls join their timeline.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires inbox.use. Emits conversation.linked.

post.summary: Text a customer from the business number. The message is queued here and the worker hands it to the carrier.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires inbox.use. Emits message.queued, conversation.created.

post.summary: Send a text that did not go out one more time.
post.description: Risk level 2. Requires inbox.use. Emits message.queued.

post.summary: Record that a customer asked not to be texted (or agreed to texts again) outside of a STOP or START text.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires inbox.use. Emits person.opted_out, person.opted_in.

post.summary: Call a customer from the browser. Returns what the browser dials with; customers see the business number.
post.description: Risk level 1. Requires inbox.use. Emits call.started.

post.summary: Your profile plus every organization and workspace you can reach, with your role in each.
post.description: Any signed-in user.

post.summary: One workspace with your role and a few counts.
post.description: Requires workspace.read.

post.summary: Everyone in a workspace, plus organization admins who reach it without a direct membership.
post.description: Requires members.read.

post.summary: Pending invitations for a workspace.
post.description: Requires invitations.read.

post.summary: What an invitation link is for, before accepting it. Never reveals the full invitee address.
post.description: Any signed-in user.

post.summary: Who changed what in a workspace, newest first.
post.description: Requires audit.read.

post.summary: The workspace’s pipelines with their stages and how many leads sit in each.
post.description: Requires records.read.

post.summary: Companies in the workspace, searchable, with people and open-lead counts.
post.description: Requires records.read.

post.summary: One company with its details and people.
post.description: Requires records.read.

post.summary: People in the workspace: search by name, phone, email or street, filter by tag, company or owner.
post.description: Requires records.read.

post.summary: One person with company, owner, tags and counts (the Customer 360 header).
post.description: Requires records.read.

post.summary: The workspace’s tags and how many records use each.
post.description: Requires records.read.

post.summary: A pipeline as a board: stages in order, each with its leads, count and total value.
post.description: Requires records.read.

post.summary: Leads as a list, newest change first, with filters.
post.description: Requires records.read.

post.summary: One lead with its card details and the stages of its pipeline.
post.description: Requires records.read.

post.summary: Tasks for you or everyone, open or done, with due buckets in the workspace’s time zone.
post.description: Requires records.read.

post.summary: Everything that happened on a person, company or lead, newest first.
post.description: Requires records.read.

post.summary: Files attached to a person, company or lead.
post.description: Requires records.read.

post.summary: An import’s progress, result and the rows that failed.
post.description: Requires records.import.

post.summary: Recent imports in the workspace.
post.description: Requires records.import.

post.summary: Existing people or companies that look like the one being typed (same email, phone or name).
post.description: Requires records.read.

post.summary: The numbers on the home screen: open leads and value, leads without a next action, tasks due and overdue.
post.description: Requires records.read.

post.summary: Where texting and calls stand: the business number, the carrier registration, the next step, and the texting rules.
post.description: Requires inbox.use.

post.summary: Conversations newest first: mine, unassigned or everyone’s; open, snoozed or closed; texts or email; with search.
post.description: Requires inbox.use.

post.summary: Unread and open counts for the badges, and how many customers are waiting too long.
post.description: Requires inbox.use.

post.summary: One conversation with the customer beside it: contact details, open lead, open tasks, and whether a text can go out now.
post.description: Requires inbox.use.

post.summary: The messages and calls in one conversation, newest first.
post.description: Requires inbox.use.

post.summary: One message, as it appears in the thread.
post.description: Requires inbox.use.
